articles.title: Wildfire smoke blankets the U.S. — here’s how a box fan and a filter can protect your lungs
articles.summary: Smoke from massive wildfires in Canada and Minnesota has pushed air quality to hazardous levels across a huge swath of the U.S. A DIY air purifier using a box fan and MERV 13 filter can offer crucial protection.

articles.title: Xi Jinping calls for global AI cooperation, slams U.S. tech curbs as ‘overstretching’ security
articles.summary: Speaking at Shanghai’s World AI Conference, Xi Jinping urged nations to treat AI development as a ‘symphony of global cooperation’ and announced a new 29-country AI organization, seen as a counter to the U.S.-led Pax Silica.

articles.title: Burnham finalizes cabinet ahead of Monday PM takeover, vows social care reform
articles.summary: Incoming UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham says he is finalizing his cabinet picks and will announce them Monday. He pledged to use significant political capital to reform the long-neglected social care system.
